brand.name: Pearl & Co.

style: Isometric low-poly 3D diorama floating as a small rounded island on a plain solid #F5EDE0 background with a soft contact shadow beneath it. Soft matte clay render, rounded toy-model shapes, gentle warm studio lighting, soft long shadows and a tilt-shift miniature look. Cohesive palette of cream #F5EDE0, taro #9B7EBD, caramel #C88A5A, matcha #8FB98A, plum #3A2E48. Highly detailed, centered composition, absolutely no text, letters, numbers or logos.
